records.name: Burnaby, British Columbia
records.feeSummary: Canada has no EU or EEA fee category. The line is drawn at Canadian citizenship or permanent residence, so a Danish student pays the full international rate everywhere, with no reciprocal arrangement of any kind.
records.ibRule: Canadian universities normally require the full IB Diploma and then name prerequisite subjects for the programme. Toronto accepts prerequisites at Standard or Higher Level; UBC requires at least three Higher Level courses in the Diploma and assesses the subjects relevant to your intended field; McGill expects a 5 or better in every Higher and Standard Level subject for most programmes, which is a floor per subject rather than a total. The rule with the longest reach is mathematics: Toronto counts Mathematics: Applications and Interpretations SL towards Advanced Functions only, UBC excludes it from its science programmes, the Faculty of Management, Sauder and the Vancouver School of Economics, and McGill will not take it as a mathematics prerequisite at all. Dalhousie accepts it.
records.englishTaught: The whole system outside Quebec, and much of it inside. Every province except Quebec teaches primarily in English, and Quebec has three large English-language universities, two of which are in this record.

records.name: Akita
records.ibRule: There is no national rule to find. A full IB Diploma satisfies the twelve-years-of-schooling condition that Japanese universities apply to foreign applicants, and each programme then sets its own standard on top. The University of Tokyo's College of Design lists the IB Diploma first among the qualifications its Route B accepts, alongside the Abitur, the Baccalauréat, GCE and International A-levels and the European Baccalaureate; Keio's PEARL accepts an IB Diploma or predicted grades. Whether any programme publishes a minimum point score was not established in this pass.
records.englishTaught: A few dozen programmes nationally, named rather than general. The UTokyo College of Design from September 2027; Waseda's six English-based schools; Keio's PEARL and GIGA; Sophia's Faculty of Liberal Arts; ICU's single bilingual liberal-arts degree; Tohoku's Future Global Leadership courses; Kyushu's international undergraduate programmes; Nagoya's G30; Tsukuba's Bachelor's Programme in Global Issues; Kyoto's iUP; APU's three colleges; and Akita International University, where every class is in English. Temple University Japan awards an American degree in Tokyo. A national total was not established.

records.name: Daejeon
records.ibRule: There is no national rule. Each university reads the IB transcript inside its own international admission track, and the category that matters is the one for applicants who completed the entire curriculum outside Korea — Seoul National University calls it 글로벌인재특별전형 II, 'those who completed the entire curriculum overseas'. That category is what removes the Suneung from the question. Whether any institution publishes a minimum IB point score was not established in this pass, and anything quoted on an agent site should be treated as unverified.
records.englishTaught: Concentrated rather than widespread, and named rather than general. Yonsei UIC (sixteen majors), KAIST, UNIST, GIST and Handong teach undergraduates in English as a matter of policy; Korea University's Division of International Studies, Sungkyunkwan's Global tracks, Ewha's Division of International Studies and Scranton Honors Program, and Kyung Hee's College of International Studies are the English-medium entry points at otherwise Korean-medium universities. National totals were not established.

ev-unsw-international-fees-2026.claim: UNSW Sydney publishes 2026 international undergraduate tuition per unit of credit by faculty, from AUD 985 for Arts to AUD 1,180 for Accounting and Actuarial Studies, on a standard full-time year of 48 units of credit.

ev-uac-ib-combined-rank-2026.claim: For offers made from August 2026, an IB Diploma score converts to an Australian Combined Rank on this published schedule: 45 to 99.95, 44 to 99.75, 43 to 99.35, 42 to 98.65, 41 to 97.80, 40 to 96.85, 39 to 95.80, 38 to 94.65, 37 to 93.60, 36 to 92.25, 35 to 90.75, 34 to 89.00, 33 to 86.65, 32 to 84.20, 31 to 81.70, 30 to 79.30, 29 to 77.10, 28 to 74.65, 27 to 72.25, 26 to 69.55, 25 to 66.95 and 24 to 64.60.

ev-actac-ib-atar-method.publisher: Australasian Conference of Tertiary Admissions Centres (ACTAC)
ev-actac-ib-atar-method.claim: The IB-to-rank conversion used in Australia is a single national schedule agreed by all the state and territory tertiary admissions centres, re-determined each February, and it is used for tertiary entrance in every Australian jurisdiction.

ev-uac-combined-rank-national.claim: The Combined Rank is a national conversion, so an IB student can apply in any Australian state or territory and be compared with local applicants on the same scale as the ATAR.

ev-ubc-tuition-2026.claim: UBC's 2026/27 international undergraduate tuition runs from CAD 51,530.40 for a full year of Arts to CAD 66,199.66 for first-year Engineering and CAD 66,678.30 for Commerce, and UBC caps the annual increase for a student starting in 2026/27 at 3 per cent for the following four years.

ev-utoronto-fee-timing.claim: The University of Toronto does not publish a tuition figure for the year you would be applying for. Its fees are finalised in the spring of the year of entry, so an applicant deciding in January 2027 is working from the 2026/27 schedule.

ev-utoronto-ib-2027.claim: The University of Toronto admits on the full IB Diploma with English HL or SL, assesses on predicted or final results excluding bonus points, accepts prerequisites at either level, treats Mathematics: Applications and Interpretations SL as satisfying Advanced Functions only, and does not accept the IB Career-related Programme at all.

ev-ubc-ib-2027.claim: UBC requires a completed IB Diploma including at least three Higher Level courses and a minimum of 24 points including bonus points, says openly that most programmes need more than that, requires at least a 3 in IB English A, will not accept Mathematics: Applications and Interpretations SL for its science programmes, Sauder or the Vancouver School of Economics, and decides initially on interim grades before confirming on final IB results.

ev-mcgill-ib-2027.claim: McGill considers IB applicants on predicted results, expects at least a 5 in every Higher and Standard Level subject for most programmes, will not accept Mathematics: Applications and Interpretations SL as a mathematics prerequisite, publishes its typical admitted ranges out of 42, and sets 15 January for the application and 1 March for supporting documents.

ev-dalhousie-ib.claim: Dalhousie admits IB Diploma holders at 26 points including bonus points, accepts either Mathematics course at either level against its mathematics requirement, and unlike Toronto admits students on the IB Career-related Programme.

ev-studyindenmark-fees.claim: Higher education is free for EU/EEA and Swiss citizens; other students pay roughly EUR 6,000–16,000 per year.

ev-ufsn-ib-eksaminer.claim: An IB Diploma of 24 points or more gives access to every higher education programme in Denmark, subject to programme-specific requirements.

ev-ufsn-ib-karakterer.claim: IB total points convert to the Danish 7-point grade average via a table re-issued annually and published by 1 March for that summer's intake.

ev-ufsn-ib-fagniveauer.claim: The official mapping of IB subjects and levels onto Danish A, B and C levels, including both post-2019 mathematics courses.

ev-kmk-ib-agreement.publisher: Kultusministerkonferenz, Zentralstelle für ausländisches Bildungswesen (KMK ZAB)
ev-kmk-ib-agreement.claim: The KMK agreement of 10.03.1986 in the version of 15.06.2023 sets which IB subject combinations give German university entrance, and it is a subject rule rather than a points rule.

ev-hea-free-fees.claim: Eligible EU, EEA, Swiss and UK students on a first undergraduate degree pay no tuition under the Free Fees Initiative, but do pay an annual student contribution.

ev-cao-timetable.claim: Applications open in early November and close on 1 February at 17:00, with a discounted fee before 20 January. Change of Mind opens 5 May and closes 1 July at 17:00. Round A offers are issued on 6 July and Round 1 on 26 August, after Leaving Certificate results on 21 August.

ev-jp-utokyo-cod-2027.publisher: UTokyo College of Design, University of Tokyo
ev-jp-utokyo-cod-2027.claim: The University of Tokyo opens a new English-taught undergraduate faculty, the UTokyo College of Design, in September 2027. It takes 100 students on a five-year integrated bachelor's and master's programme through two routes, and Route B is for applicants using international qualifications, the International Baccalaureate Diploma named first among them. Applications run from 15 October 2026 at 09:00 to 5 November 2026 at 17:00 JST.

ev-jp-keio-pearl-2027.claim: Keio's PEARL economics degree admits about 100 students for entry on 22 September 2027 through three separate application periods, the last of which closes on 7 April 2027, and it accepts an IB Diploma or predicted IB grades.

ev-jp-mext-ug-2027-guidelines.publisher: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT), Japan
ev-jp-mext-ug-2027-guidelines.claim: The MEXT undergraduate scholarship on the Embassy Recommendation runs for five years from April 2027 to March 2032, beginning with one year of preparatory education in Japanese. It pays 117,000 yen a month, waives entrance examination, matriculation and tuition fees and provides an economy air ticket. Applicants must be born on or after 2 April 2002 and have completed twelve years of schooling by March 2027, and in principle must arrive in Japan between 1 and 7 April 2027.

ev-duo-collegegeld.claim: The statutory tuition fee for 2026–2027 is €2,694. The 2027–2028 figure is not yet published.

ev-nuffic-ib-level.claim: Nuffic compares the full IB Diploma to a Dutch VWO diploma, and DP Course Results to vwo-deelcertificaten for the subjects passed.

ev-nuffic-ib-grades.claim: Nuffic describes the IB grading scale and the diploma requirements but publishes no conversion from IB points to the Dutch 1–10 scale.

ev-auckland-international-fees-2026.claim: University of Auckland international undergraduate tuition for 2026 runs from NZD 40,225 for a Bachelor of Arts to NZD 86,561 for the later years of Medicine and Surgery, for a full-time year of 120 points, plus a Student Services Fee of NZD 9.44 per point, about NZD 1,132.80 a year; the indicative 2027 Bachelor of Arts fee is NZD 42,236.40.

ev-auckland-ib-2027.claim: The University of Auckland admits IB candidates on the full Diploma with at least 24 points, treats the IB total itself as the rank score with no conversion, and publishes the rank score each programme guarantees entry at: 26 for Arts, Fine Arts, Music, Psychology and most Science; 27 for Commerce, Communication, Design, Property, Urban Planning and Global Studies; 28 for Biomedical Science and Health Sciences; 31 for Architectural Studies and Nursing; 32 for Engineering (Honours); 34 for Engineering conjoints.

ev-vuw-ib.publisher: Te Herenga Waka - Victoria University of Wellington
ev-vuw-ib.claim: Victoria University of Wellington admits on the IB Diploma with a minimum of 24 points, with literacy met by English as Language A (literature, or language and literature) at Standard or Higher Level or Language B at Higher Level, and numeracy by any mathematics subject, and states that applicants meeting this and any degree-specific requirement are automatically accepted.

ev-canterbury-ib.claim: The University of Canterbury admits anyone awarded the IB Diploma, with literacy met by English as Language A at Standard or Higher Level or Language B at Higher Level and numeracy by any mathematics subject, and states no separate points minimum.

ev-massey-rank-score.claim: Massey University gives an IB candidate a rank score equal to their IB total and sets the Preferential Entry Score for most undergraduate qualifications at 26 points.

ev-aut-ib.claim: AUT states that an IB candidate meets University Entrance with the IB Diploma awarded at a minimum of 24 points, with literacy met by an English subject from IB Group 1 and numeracy by any mathematics subject from IB Group 5.

ev-samordna-frister.publisher: Samordna opptak (Norwegian Universities and Colleges Admission Service)
ev-samordna-frister.claim: Applications open 1 February and close 15 April at 23:59, with documentation due the same day. Education finished during the spring may be uploaded until 1 July, which is also the last date to change the order of your choices.

ev-sg-ntu-ib-dates.claim: For IB Diploma holders entering in AY2027-28, NTU's online application runs 15 October 2026 to 19 March 2027, supporting documents are due 22 March 2027, offers are released between March and May 2027, and a student sitting the May 2027 session must submit actual IB results within three days of their release in July 2027 — but may not apply at all to Medicine, Renaissance Engineering, or Arts and Science (Academic Discipline & Education).

ev-sg-nus-important-dates.claim: For AY2027/2028 NUS runs the IB Diploma as its own applicant group with an application period of 16 December 2026 to 17 February 2027, the same window as for other international qualifications, and tells IB applicants sitting the May 2027 examination that they will hear by the third week of July 2027. Offers are accepted through a shared Joint Acceptance Portal whose windows are not yet confirmed.

ev-kr-snu-spring-2027.publisher: Seoul National University, Office of Admissions
ev-kr-snu-spring-2027.claim: Seoul National University's Global Talent Special Admission for Spring 2027 entry took online applications from 6 to 9 July 2026, interviewed on 18 September 2026, published a preliminary result on 16 October 2026 and the final result on 20 November 2026. Type II of the admission is for applicants who completed their entire schooling outside Korea.

ev-kr-gks-2027-eligibility.publisher: National Institute for International Education (NIIED), Ministry of Education, Republic of Korea
ev-kr-gks-2027-eligibility.claim: A 2027 GKS undergraduate applicant must be born on or after 1 March 2002, must have graduated or be expected to graduate by 31 December 2026, and takes one year of Korean language training before four to six years of degree study, so the award runs five to seven years.

ev-ua-se-bachelor-requirements.claim: General entry to a Swedish bachelor requires completed upper secondary education, English to the level of Swedish English 6, and mathematics to the level of Swedish Mathematics 1a/1b/1c. Specific requirements are set per programme.

ev-ae-ku-ib.publisher: Khalifa University of Science and Technology
ev-ae-ku-ib.claim: Khalifa University requires the full IB Diploma with six HL/SL subjects excluding Islamic Education, a minimum of 4 in each subject and 24 points in total, with Mathematics mandatory plus one science, and grants advanced standing credit for HL scores of 6 or higher.

ev-ae-rit-dubai-dates.claim: RIT Dubai is accepting applications for Fall 2027, with an Early Admission Phase until 15 January, a Regular Admission Phase until 31 May and an application deadline of 22 August, after which applications are reviewed on space availability. Its IB minimum is 28 points for engineering and 24 for computing, business, psychology and new media design.

ev-ucas-dates-2027.claim: For 2027 entry: applications open 12 May 2026, can be submitted from 1 September 2026, with equal consideration on 15 October 2026 for Oxford, Cambridge, medicine, dentistry and veterinary medicine, and 13 January 2027 for most other courses. Clearing opens 2 July 2027 and the final date is 23 September 2027.

ev-uc-ib-credit.publisher: University of California, Office of the President (UC Admissions)
ev-uc-ib-credit.claim: The University of California awards 6 quarter units for a full IB Diploma scored 30 or above, and 8 quarter units for each Higher Level exam graded 5, 6 or 7 — usually 24 quarter units in total on top of the diploma award.

ev-mit-ib-credit.publisher: MIT Office of the First Year
ev-mit-ib-credit.claim: MIT gives credit only for Higher Level IB exams, only at grade 7, gives no credit at all for IB Biology, Chemistry or Information Technology in a Global Society, and gives 18.01 for HL Mathematics, 8.01 for HL Physics and nine units of unrestricted elective credit for each applicable humanities, arts or social science exam.

ev-yale-testing-policy.publisher: Yale University, Office of Undergraduate Admissions
ev-yale-testing-policy.claim: Yale requires an ACT or SAT score from every first-year applicant and treats IB results as an optional addition to that score rather than a substitute for it.

ev-harvard-deadlines-2027.publisher: Harvard College Admissions and Financial Aid
ev-harvard-deadlines-2027.claim: Harvard requires the Common Application from every first-year applicant, international and American alike, with a Restrictive Early Action deadline of 1 November and a Regular Decision deadline of 1 January, a 95 USD fee, a required SAT or ACT, and IB actual or predicted scores accepted in place of a test only where testing is genuinely inaccessible.

ev-uc-dates-fall-2027.publisher: University of California, Office of the President (UC Admissions)
ev-uc-dates-fall-2027.claim: For fall 2027 entry the University of California application opens on 1 August 2026, must be filed between 1 and 30 November 2026, decisions are released during March 2027, admitted first-year students must submit their Statement of Intent to Register by 1 May 2027, and official IB examination results must reach the campus by 15 July 2027.
